decisions.decision: Health classification thresholds set conservatively: critical when any failed job exists OR >5 failures in 24h, degraded when >0 failures in 24h OR pending job age >300s (5min). This balances alerting sensitivity with false-positive reduction.
decisions.rationale: Prevents alert fatigue while catching genuinely degraded states early.

decisions.decision: All 9 queue stat queries execute in parallel via Promise.all() with independent .catch() error handling. No query chaining.
decisions.rationale: Minimizes endpoint latency; each query is O(1) on indexed columns (state, created_on, archived_on). Parallel execution adds ~30-50ms instead of ~200ms sequential.
